senses.gloss: m. (= קוּפָּה) basket; ק׳ ומחוק the peddlar’s basket with the strike which he carries with him.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 8:4">Tosef. Ḥull. VIII, 4</cite> [read:] <he>נותנן בק׳ ובמ׳ ומפשילן וכ׳</he> he may put them (the fowl and the cheese) into the basket and throw them over his shoulder.
